title: do I like everything I see? no… but then I crash out about it 🤣 #thea...
transcript: Let's talk about hating theater. Cause I don't hate a lot of theater, but when I really hate something, I really hate it. I just saw a play on Broadway that I like, really, really hate it. I'm not gonna name names, because here's the thing. This was a play that was just not for me. And that is okay. I don't think, like, the play was bad or the production was bad. I just hated every second of it. I posted to my close friends and I was like, hated this. And a bunch of people were like, what? I loved it. I loved it. And I was like, you know what? Good for you. I want people to like theater. That's where I fall in. It is, I think a lot of people are trying to convince me, like, why I should like it. And I was like, no, I really didn't like it. And again, like, do I think it was a badly written play? Not necessarily, but did I enjoy one single second of watching it? No. If you see theater and you don't like it, that is fine. You don't need to convince people that it's a bad show. It might just not be for you. And you can do something and you can love it. And your friend might hate it. And you know what? You don't need to convince them to love it, because again, it just might not be for them. You Might be able to guess what the play was if you follow me anywhere that's not here, cause I did post about it elsewhere. I didn't like, look into the play before seeing it, and maybe that was good, but I also. I think maybe that was bad. I just don't really like plays where everybody is terrible to each other and it's just terrible people. I like having a play where I can root for somebody or something. I don't know, maybe I'm too optimistic. It was an interesting character study about characters that I did not find interesting. I felt like I was being tortured. But no one in it was bad. I. I just didn't enjoy it. I also went alone, which maybe like wasn't helpful cause I had no one to like, talk through it with. But I'm in my head about it a little bit, so that's why we're here talking. Cause I really don't like not liking things. I for the most part really enjoy things and so when I find something that I like really hate, I just. It hits me very specifically. But I really don't like not liking things. Only it is the last show I'm seeing this year and so I have to find something else cause I cannot end my year on that note. Maybe I'll just go see Hayden son again.
